text: Entry Requirements 1. Hold a high school diploma or above; 2.Aged 16 years or above, in good health, non-Chinese citizens. Specific requirements shall follow the Document No.12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC; 3.Pass the entrance examination; 4.Hold a valid score report of the CSCA (China Scholastic CompetencyAssessment for Undergraduate Admission). Chinese Language Program: Professional Chinese (Humanities) (HSK Level 4 or above is exempt fromthis section), Mathematics
